title: Mar Ukban
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:8, Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha and Rabbi Zeira speak, one in the name of Mar Ukban and one in the name of Rav Nachman bar Yehudah. It appears that the latter should read Rav Nachman bar Yaakov, as in 7:1 there: Rabbi Yonah and Rabbi Yose speak, one in the name of Mar Ukban and one in the name of Rav Nachman bar Yaakov. In 8:5 there, Mar Ukban speaks in Rav’s name. It is very plausible that he is the unqualified Mar Ukva, the Exilarch.

notes.text: The Yehudah-toYaakov correction and identification with Mar Ukva the Exilarch are Hyman’s suggestions, not established identifications.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:8 reads Rav Nachman bar Yehudah, 7:1 reads Rav Nachman bar Yaakov, and 8:5 has Mar Ukban in Rav’s name. These distinct occurrences support the cited wording without establishing Hyman’s proposed harmonization or identification with the Exilarch.
